payout_quote: Referring member can receive a $50 bonus for each friend (up to $1,000) once program requirements are met by the referred friend.
steps: Be a Travis Credit Union member with a Prime Share account and a TCU personal checking account, enrolled in online banking.
Access your Refer-A-Friend portal in digital banking to get your unique referral link and share it via social media or email.
Your friend registers with your link, qualifies for TCU membership, and opens a Prime Share Account plus an eligible TCU personal checking account (Access, Free, Investor, or Cheques Gratis).
Within the first 90 days of account opening, your friend completes ONE of: twelve (12)+ debit card purchases of $10+ each (ATM excluded), OR one or more direct deposits totaling $250+.
The $50 cash bonus is deposited into your TCU Personal Checking account within 60 days after qualifications are met.
catches: The $50 is deposited to your checking account - but not until up to 60 days after your friend qualifies.
Cap: $1,000 in Refer-A-Friend bonuses per calendar year (20 referrals).
Your friend must be genuinely new: no existing TCU personal checking, and none closed within the preceding 36 months.
Qualifying direct deposits must be real payroll/personal income via ACH - Zelle, Venmo, debit/credit card credits, and external bank transfers do not count.
Membership requires a Prime Share Account ($5 non-refundable fee + $5 minimum deposit).
The reward is considered interest and reported on IRS form 1099-INT.
Offer may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice; cannot be combined with other checking offers.
US residents only, 18+; TCU employees excluded; your checking account must be open, in good standing, with balance > $0 when the bonus is paid.
biggest_catch: The $50 lands up to 60 days after your friend qualifies - and they must be a genuine newcomer who makes 12 debit purchases or $250+ in real payroll direct deposits within 90 days.
eligibility: TCU members with a Prime Share account and a TCU personal checking account, 18+, US residents. Referred friend must be new to TCU personal checking (none closed within 36 months).
timing: $50 cash bonus deposited into your TCU Personal Checking within 60 days after qualifications are met.
